about: Ratchet for the files-only app checks G13-G20 of scripts/preflight.mjs and for the shell-contract rules SC-R1..SC-R9 of packages/release/shell-contract.mjs, which preflight runs too. known.<repo> (lowercased --repo basename; rightkit for this checkout) lists the identities `rule|file|subject` (no line numbers) of findings that exist today: preflight prints them as KNOWN and does not fail. A new finding fails; a listed identity that is no longer found fails as STALE, so the list only shrinks. Never add an entry to hide a new defect: fix it. A person pastes `node scripts/preflight.mjs --repo <dir> --worktree --print-baseline` here; preflight never writes this file.
